_note: Input schemas for the DB tool catalog (GET /v1/tools and the hosted MCP tools/list), written from each handler in src/routes/tools/index.ts on 2026-11-03. Applied by migrate-startup.js. `schemas` replace a tool's schemaJson when it has no properties; `descriptions` fill in a property's description, null removes a property the handler never reads, and `add` publishes fields the handler reads that the old schema left out.

question.description: The question or problem to analyze, up to 10,000 characters.

context.description: Optional background text for the analysis; only the first 8,000 characters are used.

reasoning_depth.description: standard (Sonnet, 2,048 tokens) or deep (Opus, 4,096 tokens, costs about 2x credits); any other value returns 400. x402-paid calls without a BYOK key are served at standard.

domain.description: Domain name to look up via RDAP, e.g. example.com; a leading http(s):// and any path are stripped.

limit.description: Number of daily Fear & Greed index entries to return, newest first (default 7, clamped to 1-30).
Number of top coins by market cap to return (default 10, clamped to 1-100).

currency.description: Fiat or crypto currency code for prices, e.g. usd or eur (lowercased; default usd).

symbol.description: Optional coin to filter headlines by, as a ticker or name, e.g. BTC or bitcoin; alias: coin. Omit for general crypto news.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles (default 10, clamped to 1-20).

symbol.description: Coin as a CoinGecko id or common ticker, e.g. bitcoin or BTC (tickers like BTC/ETH/SOL are mapped to ids); alias: coin.

days.description: How many days of OHLC candles to return, passed to CoinGecko as-is (CoinGecko accepts 1, 7, 14, 30, 90, 180, 365); default 7.

currency.description: Quote currency in lowercase, e.g. usd (default usd).

symbol.description: Coin as a CoinGecko id or common ticker, e.g. bitcoin or BTC (tickers like BTC/ETH/SOL are mapped to ids); alias: coin.

currency.description: Quote currency in lowercase, e.g. usd or eur (default usd); the server does not lowercase it, so always send lowercase.

symbol.description: Full CoinGecko coin id, e.g. bitcoin or ethereum (lowercased). Tickers like BTC are NOT mapped and return 404.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate with gpt-image-1, e.g. 'a watercolor fox in a forest'; screened by content moderation.

size.description: Image size in pixels; other values fall back to 1024x1024 (x402-paid calls are always 1024x1024).

quality.description: Image quality: low, medium or high (aliases: standard/vivid/natural = medium, hd = high); any other value becomes medium. High quality costs more credits; x402-paid calls are capped at medium.

n.description: Number of images; always capped at 1.

domain.description: Domain name to check for registration via RDAP, e.g. example.com; lowercased, and a leading http(s):// and any path are stripped.
Company domain to search with Hunter.io, e.g. stripe.com.

first_name.description: Person's first name; with last_name, switches to a single-person email lookup. Ignored unless last_name is also given.

last_name.description: Person's last name; with first_name, switches to a single-person email lookup. Ignored unless first_name is also given.

to.description: One recipient email address, e.g. alice@example.com; must contain @ and may not contain commas or newlines (single recipient only).

subject.description: Email subject line, 200 characters or fewer.

body.description: Plain-text body (up to 10,000 chars used). Either body or html is required.

html.description: HTML body (up to 20,000 chars used; script tags and inline on* handlers are stripped). Either body or html is required.

from.description: Custom sender address; only honored when the server has ALLOW_CUSTOM_EMAIL_FROM=true, otherwise the default Arch Tools sender is used.

claim.description: The statement to fact-check, e.g. 'The Great Wall of China is visible from space'; may also be sent as a ?claim= query parameter.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate with gpt-image-1; screened by content moderation.

size.description: Image size in pixels; other values fall back to 1024x1024 (x402-paid calls are always 1024x1024).

quality.description: Image quality: low, medium or high (aliases: standard/vivid/natural = medium, hd = high); any other value becomes medium. High quality costs more credits; x402-paid calls are capped at medium.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (downloaded by the server, max about 22 MB). Either image_url or image_base64 is required.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes; used instead of image_url when both are given. Either image_url or image_base64 is required.

size.description: Output resolution for remove.bg: auto, preview, full, or hd (hd is sent as full); other values return 400.

query.description: News search query, e.g. 'OpenAI funding'; may also be sent as a ?query= query parameter.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles (default 5, capped at 10); may also be sent as ?limit=.

query.description: Research topic or question, e.g. 'state of solid-state batteries'; alias: topic (also accepted as ?query= or ?topic= query parameters).

depth.description: standard (5 sources, concise report) or deep (10 sources, advanced search, longer report); any value other than deep behaves as standard.

query.description: Natural-language search query, e.g. 'startups building AI agents for accounting'.

num_results.description: Number of results (default 5, clamped to 1-20); alias: limit, which takes precedence if both are sent.

type.description: Exa search mode: neural (default) or keyword; other values return 400. Ignored when documents is provided.

documents.description: Optional list of your own text documents to rank against the query locally by keyword overlap instead of searching the web with Exa.

to.description: One recipient email address, e.g. alice@example.com; must contain @ and may not contain commas or newlines (single recipient only).

subject.description: Email subject line, 200 characters or fewer.

body.description: Plain-text body (up to 10,000 chars used). Either body or html is required.

html.description: HTML body (up to 20,000 chars used; script tags and inline on* handlers are stripped). Either body or html is required.

from.description: Custom sender address; only honored when the server has ALLOW_CUSTOM_EMAIL_FROM=true, otherwise the default Arch Tools sender is used.

namespace.description: Required label grouping this conversation session, e.g. 'support-bot' (truncated to 100 chars).

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt for every turn in the session (truncated to 4,000 chars); alias: system.

model.description: Model for the session: alias claude, gpt, gpt4 or gpt-4 (case-insensitive), or an exact id; other values return 400. Default claude-sonnet-4-6. x402-paid sessions are pinned to claude-sonnet-4-6 for premium models.

session_id.description: Session id returned by session-create, e.g. sess_3f2a...; must belong to the same caller.

message.description: The user message to send in the session, up to 10,000 characters.

text.description: Text to speak, up to 5,000 characters (credit cost grows with length).

voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice id, letters/digits/_/- only (default EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL).

stability.description: ElevenLabs voice stability from 0 to 1 (default 0.5; not range-checked by the server).

similarity_boost.description: ElevenLabs voice similarity boost from 0 to 1 (default 0.75; not range-checked by the server).

query.description: Token name or ticker to search on CoinGecko, e.g. solana or SOL; aliases: text, symbol. Use the returned id with other crypto tools.

audio_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the audio file (mp3, wav, ogg, webm, mp4/m4a), fetched within 60 s and limited to 25 MB by default.

language.description: Optional ISO-639-1 language code of the audio, e.g. en; auto-detected by Whisper if omitted.

prompt.description: Optional context hint passed to Whisper, e.g. names or jargon to spell correctly.
Text description of the video to generate with Runway; screened by content moderation.

duration.description: Video length in seconds: 5 or 10 only, sent as a JSON number (a string like "5" returns 400). Default 5.

aspect_ratio.description: 16:9 (landscape, default) or 9:16 (portrait); 1280:720, 720:1280, 1280:768 and 768:1280 are also accepted. Other values return 400.

goal.description: The goal to work through step by step, e.g. 'plan a product launch email campaign'; aliases: task, objective.

context.description: Optional background information to include with the goal.

steps.description: Number of steps the model should plan (default 3, clamped to 1-10); alias: max_steps.

ai-generate.model: Explicit model; overrides mode. Accepts aliases claude, gpt/gpt4/gpt-4, gemini, grok (case-insensitive) or an exact id: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash-lite, grok-4.3, grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning (retired gemini-1.5/2.0 and grok-2/3 names are remapped). Unknown models return 400. If omitted, mode decides (default smart = claude-sonnet-4-6).
ai-generate.max_tokens: Maximum output tokens (default 1000, served value capped at 4096). Credit cost is 20 plus 20 per 1,000 requested tokens above 1,000.

barcode-generate.width: Output width in pixels (default 250, 50-2000); the barcode is scaled to fit.
barcode-generate.format: Alias for type: code128 (default, up to 80 characters) or qr (a real QR code, up to 1,000 characters). Other values return 400.
barcode-generate.height: Output height in pixels for code128 (default 100, 30-1000); a QR code is always square.
barcode-generate.include_text: Print the encoded value under a code128 barcode (default true).

convert-format.to: Target format: json, yaml, csv or xml when from is a structured format; base64 or hex when from is text; text (or string) or hex when from is base64. Unsupported targets return 400.
convert-format.from: Format of the input: json, yaml, csv, xml, text (or string), or base64. Unsupported formats return 400.

generate-hash.algorithm: Hash algorithm: sha256 (default), sha512, sha384, sha1 or md5; other values return 400.

generate-uuid.type: Alias for version: v1 for a timestamp-based UUID; any other value (default v4) gives a random v4 UUID (or the api_key/token value selected by format).
generate-uuid.count: How many values to generate (default 1, clamped to 1-100).

image-generate.width: SVG width in pixels written into the model prompt and viewBox (default 400; not validated).
image-generate.height: SVG height in pixels written into the model prompt and viewBox (default 300; not validated).

ocr-extract.media_type: MIME type of image_base64: image/jpeg (default), image/png, image/gif or image/webp; other values fall back to image/jpeg. Not used when the image is downloaded from image_url (the download's Content-Type is used).

qr-code.format: Output format: png (default, returned as a data URL) or svg (SVG markup); any other value returns png.

rss-parse.limit: Maximum number of feed items to return (default 20; no upper cap).

search-web.limit: Number of results to return (default 5, clamped to 1-10); num_results is accepted as an alias.

summarize.style: Summary style: paragraph (default), bullets, tldr, headline or executive; unknown values fall back to paragraph.

transform-text.mode: Transformation: uppercase (default), lowercase, titlecase, slug, camel, pascal, snake, kebab, base64_encode, base64_decode, reverse, trim or word_count. Also accepts upper, lower, title, camelCase, snakeCase, kebabCase, pascalCase, and the field name operation. Other values return 400.

webhook-send.method: HTTP method for the webhook call: POST (default), PUT or PATCH (case-insensitive); any other value is sent as POST.

size.description: Image size in pixels (default 256, clamped to 64-1024).

error_correction.description: QR error-correction level: L, M (default), Q or H.

mode.description: Diff granularity: words (default), chars, or lines (unified is the same as lines).

selector.description: Optional CSS selector; returns only the text of the matching element(s).
